reference_packs.title: Alpine editorial retreat
reference_packs.description: Build a polished editorial website for an alpine retreat. Establish the visitor's next action before laying out the page. Compose a large photographic opening, quiet navigation, an expressive headline, readable supporting copy and one clear primary action. Use the supplied hero/exterior/interior/footer photographs for their intended roles; composition references guide spacing rather than becoming flattened screenshots of the interface.

reference_packs.title: Architectural landscape journey
reference_packs.description: Build an architectural property website with independent sky, residence and foreground planes. Establish a strong static composition before adding motion. Choose either the warm or violet image family rather than blending conflicting palettes accidentally. The warm family has eight images and three property-card photographs; the violet family has seven images and no standalone property cards. Only the two residence subjects and two foreground subjects have real transparency. Opaque continuations require deliberate crop/mask blending.

reference_packs.title: Orbital portal experience
reference_packs.description: Build a self-contained HTML document with inline CSS/JavaScript and no external code libraries. Its media remains external, so “self-contained” does not mean offline-ready. The core interaction is a rounded canvas mask over screen-locked imagery: pointer tilt moves the window while its image stays fixed, then a click expands it to full-screen footage before committing the next state. A video preloader, docking logo, large condensed planet title, fact rows and custom cursor complete the composition.

reference_packs.title: Electric vehicle explorer
reference_packs.description: Build a framed electric-vehicle exploration scene with a full-car view, four image-relative hotspots and appearance menus below the frame. The hotspots are Drive, Battery, Paint and Wheels. Hood and battery interactions use authored forward/reverse films, with still cutaways for detail states. This is a compact product study, not a runtime 3D model, a combined vehicle configurator or a sales backend. React/Vite or another selected frontend can implement the state machine.
